sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Qwen3 introduces several key advancements to enhance its functionality and usability. First, it integrates two distinct operating modes, thinking mode and non-thinking mode, into a single model. This allows users to switch between these modes without alternating between different models, e.g., switching from Qwen2.5 to QwQ (Qwen Team 2024).

sources.title: qwen/qwen3-32b • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen3 32B by qwen Supports a context length of up to 131,072 tokens with YaRN (default 32k) Supports /no_think to disable reasoning, just add it at the end of your prompt Supports both thinking and non-thinking modes withe enhanced reasoning in both for significantly enhanced mathematics, coding, and commonsense Excels at creative writing, role-playing, multi-turn dialogues, and instruction ...
